pages.title: In the Past
pages.text: Almost lost to time, the cyan chalk brings ancient knowledge, often even forbidden.$(br) But who cares? After all, knowledge is knowledge, and the more, the better, right?$(br)

Despite the complexity of its manufacture, this chalk is dated as one of the oldest,$(br) perhaps even the oldest chalk ever recorded. And even after all this time,$(br) its uses are little known, but you can see just how stable it is.$()
